summary: Linked-list teardown: walks the singly linked list rooted at *this. Each node is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf(node); if the node flag byte at +8 is set, the node's first dword (payload pointer) is also freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf. After the walk, zeroes the four list fields at this+0x0..this+0xC. Structural twin of LinkedListDestructor_1db0 (00491db0).

operations.description: Walk the list starting from i = *this (head pointer at this+0x0), continuing while i is non-null.
Save the current node v3 = i for freeing.
Read the owns-payload flag v4 = *(BYTE*)(i + 8) from the node (field obj+0x8).
Advance i to the next node: i = *(DWORD*)(i + 4) (field *(obj+0x4)).
Guard on the owns-payload flag v4; when set, free the node payload.
Free the node payload pointer *v3 (field obj+0x0) via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the flag is set.
Free the node itself v3 via FreeWrapper_7bcf as the loop step.

unresolved: Node payload layout and the meaning of the owns-payload flag at +8 are caller/allocator-side.
The list owner class and whether FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) is free() or an internal heap wrapper are unresolved.
